question: Where is restaurant situated within 160 kilometers in the direction of Southern National Motorsport Park, Lucama, NC from Aquarium Outfitters Carolina, Wake Forest, NC?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Aquarium Outfitters Carolina%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wake Forest%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), target_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Southern National Motorsport Park%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lucama%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), calculated_azimuth AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, tp.geometry)) AS bearing_to_target, sp.geometry AS start_geom FROM start_point sp, target_point tp ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, calculated_azimuth ca WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ca.start_geom::geography, 160000) -- 160 kilometers = 160,000 meters AND ( -- Calculate the difference in bearing from the start point to the restaurant, -- handling the 0/360 degree wrap-around. -- We consider a restaurant to be "in the direction of" if its bearing -- from the start point is within +/- 22.5 degrees of the bearing -- from the start point to the target point (a 45-degree cone). LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ca.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ca.bearing_to_target), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ca.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ca.bearing_to_target) ) <= 22.5 );
